meta.name: visual-system-review
meta.description: Use to evaluate visual consistency, hierarchy, and design-system adherence — typography, color, spacing, density, tokens.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查设计系统一致性，优化视觉层次与排版色彩
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保产品界面视觉统一、符合设计规范。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate visual consistency and adherence to design system tokens.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure visual coherence and design system alignment.

howto.what: 当你看一个界面时，Claude会检查它的视觉层次、一致性、信息密度、文案适配、对比度和可交互元素的明确性，然后指出具体问题、提出改进建议，并标记任何不符合设计系统的地方。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude审查一个界面的视觉设计或评估其与设计系统的符合度时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个页面的视觉层次是否合理。
检查这段界面的颜色和间距是否统一。
评估这个设计是否符合我们的设计系统。
say.note: Claude会找出违规项并补充缺失的令牌。

howto.what_en: When you present a screen, Claude evaluates its visual hierarchy, consistency, density, copy fit, contrast/readability, and affordances, then lists specific issues, ranked suggestions, design-system violations, and any missing tokens or patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to review a screen's visual design or assess its compliance with a design system.

say_en.text: Review the visual hierarchy of this page.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes primary vs secondary focus.

say_en.text: Check if the colors and spacing are consistent.
say_en.note: Claude compares against the design system.

say_en.text: Evaluate this design against our design system.
say_en.note: Claude flags violations and suggests missing tokens.
